svg.title: Boundary mapping — coordinates, ownership and destination — window_block_c32_output_view_fp16
svg.desc: Direction-specific spatial boundary. Every highlighted pixel and lane has an explicit coordinate; the two layouts use different address formulas. Residual-only views are distinguished from main-input gathers.
svg.text: Boundary mapping — coordinates, ownership and destination
Plane 0; H=8, W=16; each pixel contains 16 B
Native packet address = tileBase + panelBase + chunkBase + 16·lane; first panel gives 208.
The four bytes encode Half model channels [2,3].
The load/store adapter changes physical representation while preserving the token coordinate.
A whole physical M16×C32 native tile contains 1,024 bytes. Plane strides span the full image.
A layout view is not a numerical operation. E4 decoding or final publication is a separate, source-defined step.
